comparison.objective: Seal a filled zip-top bag; candidate screens finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pinch-slide sealing and bag stabilization versus controlled pouring and orientation-dependent passage through apertures.
comparison.success_condition: All seal cells closed without excessive drag, rotation, or spill versus media recovery with washer retention and zero contamination/loss.
comparison.reason: Both manage contents safely, but the tested mechanisms and terminal outcomes differ materially.
